headline: 📰 LATEST NEWS
source: Munsif Daily / Telangana Today / The Hindu
bullets_en: Nationwide stir called on Oct 23 against SIR; Dipke, Bora to join.
Harish Rao slams government over drought preparedness.
Karnataka Dy CM writes to PM Modi, HM seeking Rs 20,585 crore drought relief from Centre.
Anbumani has sought demolition of retaining wall and walkway being built in Pallikaranai Marsh.
Vice-President calls for stronger Centre-State coordination for legal reforms.
bullets_ur: SIR ke khilaf mulk-gir ehtijaj 23 Oct ka elaan; Dipke, Bora bhi shamil honge
Harish Rao ne preparedness par sarkar sokha par tanqeed ki.
Karnataka ke Naib Wazir-e-Ala ne PM Modi aur HM ko khat likh kar Markaz se 20,585 crore rupaye ka qehra rahat maanga
Anbumani ne Pallikaranai Marsh mein tameer ho rahi retaining wall aur walkway ki demolition ka mutalba kiya hai
Naib Sadr ne qanooni islaahat ke liye markaz aur suabon ki mazboot ham-ahangi par zor diya
